caption:
5 prompts to learn any skill fast.

1. Make a 30 day plan to learn [skill], 1 hour a day.
2. What are the 20 percent of concepts that matter most?
3. Give me a small project for week 1.
4. Check my work and tell me the top 2 fixes.
5. Quiz me on what I learned this week.

Save this and start today. Send it to a friend learning something new.
